title: Relationship Between Optimal Laryngeal Mask Airway Cuff Volume and Physical Examination of Head and Neck
brief_summary: Overinflation of laryngeal mask airway cuff increase side effect like hoarseness, vocal cord paralysis, sorethroat. The investigators will study correlation between laryngeal mask airway cuff volume and pressure and physical examination of head and neck.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult (age 19-65)
* American Society of Anesthesiology Classification I-III

Exclusion Criteria:

* cardiovascular disease, cerebrovascular disease, pulmonary disease
* patient who have operation history for airway
* patient who expected difficult intubation
* patient who have risk of aspiration
